findings.issue: History regeneration calls ImageGenApp.setSeedMode, which app.js does not export. Every valid selected record throws TypeError before closeHistoryDetail() or generate(). Existing tests never execute this cross-module path.

The changed canonical history-wall.js was not synchronized to cloudflare/public/static/history-wall.js. The existing static sync gate and Worker sync test fail, and the deployed copy runs different behavior.

needs-human: The PR claims to preserve the original seed, but still sets seed: 0; computeSeedForGeneration() randomizes it even in lock mode. Issue #9 and the README request a variant using the original prompts and dimensions, with a separate composition-lock action. Choosing fixed-seed reproduction would change that established behavior.

summary: Removed the unsupported seed-lock call that crashed history regeneration, restoring consistency with the Cloudflare copy and existing variant behavior. Two new regressions execute the real frontend modules and verify the selected prompts, dimensions and tuning reach /generate; the full offline gate passes with 238 Python tests plus 26 subtests, 78 frontend tests, 138 Worker tests and browser QA. needs-human: fixed-seed reproduction contradicts the documented variant behavior; that policy was left unchanged and the original issue's real-provider visual acceptance remains unverified.
